# Security policy

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability, exposed credential, or sensitive customer data.

- For a vulnerability in this sample code, use GitHub private vulnerability reporting when it is available for the repository. Otherwise email [security@backblaze.com](mailto:security@backblaze.com) with the repository name, affected version or commit, impact, and reproduction steps.
- For a vulnerability in Backblaze products or services, use the reporting route in the [Backblaze Trust Center](https://www.backblaze.com/company/trust-center).
- For ordinary bugs, documentation corrections, or feature requests that do not contain sensitive information, open a GitHub issue.

Never include application keys, presigned URLs, bucket contents, personal data, or customer identifiers in a report. Backblaze will acknowledge and triage reports according to the applicable disclosure program; this repository does not define a separate response-time SLA.
